meta.title: Clipper — claim campaigns, get paid per view
meta.description: Claim brand campaigns, post clips on your own TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube account, and get paid per view. Free for clippers.

footer.tagline: A clipping marketplace: brands set a budget, you post clips on your own account and get paid for verified views.

hero.title: Claim a campaign. Post on your account. <hl>Get paid per view.</hl>
hero.body: Pick a brand campaign, cut the best moments, and post them on your own social account. Views are counted automatically from the platforms’ official APIs.

points.free: Free, nothing taken from your earnings

hero.cuanNote: At {rate} per 1,000 views. Every campaign has its own rate — check the card.

campaigns.title: Campaigns running now
campaigns.description: Each card shows the rate per 1,000 views and the budget left.
campaigns.emptyBody: New campaigns go live every week. Sign up so you get notified when one launches.
campaigns.errorBody: Try reloading the page in a moment.

s1.title: Claim a campaign
s1.body: Pick a campaign that fits, read the brief, and tap Claim. Your slot is held for {hours} hours.

s2.title: Connect your account
s2.body: Link your social accounts through the platform’s official login. Up to {max} accounts per platform.

s3.title: Post & submit
s3.body: Post the clip on your account with the brief’s hashtags and mentions, then pick the video in the app.

s4.title: Get paid per view
s4.body: Views are counted automatically from official APIs; your earnings grow with every views update.

payout.title: From views to balance to your bank account
payout.description: Every earning is recorded in your wallet, so you always know when you can withdraw.

pending.title: Pending first
pending.body: Earnings from views land as Pending while your clip is still being tracked.

available.title: Then Available
available.body: Once the clip is locked and clears the {days}-day hold with no fraud flag, the balance moves to Available.

withdraw.title: Withdraw to your bank
withdraw.body: Withdraw from {min}. Weekly batches are free.

kyc.title: KYC just once
kyc.body: ID and bank account verification is only asked on your first withdrawal.

followers.q: Do I need lots of followers?
followers.a: Not always. Each campaign sets its own requirements, such as minimum followers or account age, and they’re all listed on the campaign page.

views.q: Where do the view counts come from?
views.a: From the platforms’ official APIs via the accounts you connect, not screenshots. Fake or bought views get caught and those earnings are held.

fee.a: It’s free. You receive 100% of the rate shown on the campaign; platform fees are paid by the brand.

payout.a: Available balance can be withdrawn to a bank account from {min}. Withdrawals are processed in free weekly batches.

who.a: Anyone aged 18 or older. KYC (ID card) is only requested on your first withdrawal.

accounts.q: Can I use more than one account?
accounts.a: Yes, up to {max} accounts per platform. Each social account can only be connected to one clipper.

brand.title: Lots of clippers, pay only for verified views
brand.body: Set a budget and a rate per 1,000 views. Clippers cut and post your content on their accounts; you only pay for views that pass verification.

b1.title: Build a campaign
b1.body: Brief, required hashtags, rate per platform, and budget. Start from a template if you like.

b2.title: Pay the invoice
b2.body: Via QRIS or bank transfer. The campaign goes live after review and once funds arrive.

b3.title: Clippers post
b3.body: Every video is checked automatically: owned by the account, hashtags complete, posted after the claim.

b4.title: Track the report
b4.body: Valid views, clip count, and top clips in real time. Share a read-only report link with your boss.

brand.feeBody: 100% of the creator budget goes to clippers. On top of it: a {mgmt}% management fee and a {admin}% platform admin fee.
brand.feeRate: At {rate} per 1,000 views → up to {views} paid views. Taxes not included.
brand.reportNote: Illustrative numbers from the example alongside. Real reports export to CSV or share as a read-only link.
brand.managedTitle: No time to set it up yourself?
brand.managedNote: Managed package at {price} per campaign: our team handles the brief, assets, clipper curation, and the final report.
brand.managedNoteNoPrice: With the managed package, our team handles the brief, assets, clipper curation, and the final report.

ctaBand.title: Ready to start?
ctaBand.body: Sign up for free and claim your first campaign today.

campaign.claimNote: Sign in first, then connect your social account.

report.emptyBody: Numbers appear once the first clip passes validation and tracking starts.
report.note: Aggregated numbers from clips that passed validation; this report contains no clipper personal data.
report.invalidBody: This report link was revoked, has expired, or is mistyped. Ask the brand team for a new link.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong or the page has moved.
